review.note: Approved (agent-e0a3, W9 reviewer r3). A3 diff: src/styles.css rules all under .cards-view (entry-row min-width 0/max-width 100%; depth-1 card margin; research one column via .cards-view:not([data-group=research]) in the 380 px two-column rule; research preview hidden and --space-2 padding; .entry-row[data-empty]:not([data-open]):not(:focus-within) .entry-details hidden; .cards-view .reorder inset and button padding 0; .cards-view .collection-open-beside right --space-2). .cards-view is set on the section only when card view is on (ProjectSidebar.tsx:673, else list-view), so nothing reaches list view. The open-beside button keeps its 24x24 target through the shared .open-beside::after rule (styles.css:343-364), and alignment.spec 24x24 passes. ProjectSidebar.tsx adds only data-empty on entry rows: an extra attribute, no structural change (the A2 scroll-fade hunk in that file belongs to T256). Ruling on 'Notes row': ACCEPTED. The model has no notes field; the draft-status dropdown shows 'Notes' by default (value draftStatus ?? 'notes'), so it is the plan's Notes row. Edge: a status explicitly set to 'notes' counts as not empty. Fresh run PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1433 npx playwright test w9-cards alignment sidebar-selection --output test-results/T257-review -> 41 passed, 5 failed; w9-cards 4/4; tsc -b clean per worker (my tsc runs this session were clean). All 5 failures pass in notes/baseline-dev.txt and are NOT caused by A3: (1) sidebar-selection.spec.ts:485 (asserts at :518 and :531) expects the old matrix(1.04) hover grow on .entry-main, which A1/T255 removed; needs re-pin to scale 1, like T255 did in hover-emphasis.spec. (2-5) sidebar-selection.spec.ts:622 x4 (B1 palettes) time out at :680 clicking .source-item 'Open beside': C1/T264 moved the PDF field into the collapsed <details class='source-more'> (src/research/SourceForm.tsx:162-206, button at :183), so the button is hidden; the spec must open 'More details' first. tests/sidebar-selection.spec.ts is unowned; a fix task is needed before validation.
